title: Let one source-size family be checked alone, so its host-observed inventory fits the evidence summary
outcome: Let one source-size family be checked alone, so its host-observed inventory fits the evidence summary
acceptance: The all-families test still runs in normal validation: it refuses overlapping families and names every oversized file
The full quality gates pass and a Codex and a Claude review of the change are clean

docs/development.md names the exact per-family command a host runs as file-size evidence, such as `cargo test --test source_file_size -- --exact <family test> --nocapture`, and says that one family's output fits the 4096-byte verification summary

tests/source_file_size.rs has one test per guarded family, selectable by an exact test name. Run alone with --nocapture, it prints only that family's inventory lines, in the 'PATH: N physical lines (limit 2499)' form, and fails when any of that family's files is over the limit

completion.summary: guarded_families! declares each guarded source family once. It generates the FAMILIES list and one test per family, family::NAME, so a host can run one family with --exact --nocapture. That run prints one line per file in path order ("PATH: N physical lines (limit 2499)"), fails naming each file over the limit, and must fit a 3 KiB report budget. within_report_budget is tested against a size counted by hand: exactly the budget fits, one byte less is refused. docs/development.md gives the per-family and whole-tree commands and notes that plain --nocapture interleaves output across threads. Landed as da66d31, reviewed clean in two rounds; the independent evaluation passed all four criteria.
